# X6 R22 — Closure-frame-dependent resource grants: delayed future-language residual

Date: 2026-11-19. Line: RS-X6-NATIVE-TIME-DYNAMICS, task publication TP2-91D4A7C2F63805BE21A3.
Status: CONDITIONAL_AUTHOR_PROOF / EXACT_BOOLEAN_BRC_PASS / NOT_REVIEWED / NATIVE_EVENT_ADMISSION_PENDING.
Researcher attribution: EM-X6-214D9C; historical native run RUN-0ae5e5a5f746550089b9fa11. This portable scientific note does not itself constitute native PROGRESS/Result acceptance.

## Inputs and relation to earlier work

Frozen P000 V5: enterprise-math@a72226e2430ffa4786321ac86e7f0c599d5f0389:p000_reality_foundation.json (Git blob dc84bdae6595b5e237a2ad50d8b21916adb2e447).
Frozen taskbook: research_tasks/RS_X6_NATIVE_TIME_DYNAMICS_20260906.md@f41c2690daba467ecbde99615a1337e67be46ffd.
R20 establishes resource-constrained vacancy paths without grants. R21 (2026-11-19_x6_regenerative_port_future_quotient_r21.md) proves exact finite trace-language equivalence when resource costs/grants depend on the edge, and the full deterministic state suffices. R22 changes exactly that edge-only grant hypothesis: the grant on a fixed edge may depend on an intact triadic closure frame hidden from a source/signed-Port observer. The relevant current protocol is docs/RESEARCH_CONTINUATION_PROTOCOL.md#current-normative-context, plus docs/PORTABLE_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md, research_priorities/research_method.json, P000 and the joint-observer preservation contract.

## Conditional X6 whole-triad controller

Choose positive integers k,m. Work in a chart of the six-axis affine Z^6 Cell torsor. The only moving signed direction is +E1. For each lane i=0,...,m-1, use Cell sites -E1+10iE2, 0+10iE2, E1+10iE2,...,kE1+10iE2. All m lanes are disjoint; 0 is a chosen chart anchor, not an ontic origin. Label two whole-triad carriers A_i and B_i. Initially A_i occupies -E1+10iE2, B_i occupies 0+10iE2, the other k sites are vacant. All triads remain intact through transitions. A_i has a fixed valid equal-quantum triadic frame.

For B_i choose one of two P000 equal-quantum closure-valid ordered frames, F0=(E1,E2,E3) and F1=(E1,E2,E4). Both have three distinct positive nonzero primitive directions and a common +E1 port. Let theta_i=0 or 1 denote this frame; frame identity and token provenance persist during the run. For each lane introduce its own credit r_i in {0,1}, initially zero. Credit is a typed Link/Port resource, not an extra spatial dimension or physical clock.

The source/Port-labelled event b_i=(B_i,+E1) moves B_i one directed step jE1 -> (j+1)E1 for 0<=j<k, at zero cost. Only its LAST step, (k-1)E1 -> kE1, grants theta_i units of credit, capped at one. The event a_i=(A_i,+E1) moves A_i -E1 -> 0 once, after B_i has vacated 0 and provided r_i>=1, and consumes one credit. There are no further allowed steps. Distinct lanes and their credits do not interact. This is a DECLARED candidate event law; P000's TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E supplies the stable-triad premise but does not yet supply a physical inter-Cell transfer or frame-conditioned grant law.

The observer sees all successful, chronologically ordered source/signed-Port event words, including the empty word, but does not directly observe B_i frame choice, failed events, credit mutations, physical duration or spatial coordinates. Its initial public projection is identical for every theta=(theta_0,...,theta_{m-1}): the entire labelled Cell placement, all zero credit balances and the initially enabled labels are equal.

## Theorem R22.1 — Exact delayed distinction and minimum repair

Let L_h(theta) be the Boolean support of all successful words of length at most h. Then for every h<=k and all theta,theta':

  L_h(theta) = L_h(theta').

At h=k+1 one has

  L_{k+1}(theta) = L_{k+1}(theta')   iff   theta=theta'.

Thus every distinct pair of these 2^m hidden-frame histories has shortest distinguishing successful word length exactly k+1. On this fixed public initial fiber there is exactly ONE future-language equivalence class through horizon k and exactly 2^m classes from horizon k+1 onward. The exact minimum extra fixed-length memory is zero bits for h<=k and m bits for h>=k+1.

Proof. Before any a_i can occur, its local credit must become positive. The only positive credit source is the k-th b_i movement in that lane. Consequently any a_i requires at least k preceding b_i events and is impossible in a successful word of length <=k. Every such word consists only of b_i symbols, with at most k instances of any symbol, regardless of theta. This proves equality for h<=k. For each index i the length-(k+1) word w_i=b_i^k a_i succeeds iff theta_i=1: the first k b_i events are always enabled, the last one exposes Cell 0 and grants precisely theta_i credit, which a_i must consume. If theta differs from theta' at position i, w_i distinguishes the two. Equal theta yields the same deterministic transition system. Therefore the 2^m vectors induce precisely 2^m future-language classes. An exact fixed-length encoding of that initial public fiber needs at least ceil(log2 2^m)=m bits; storing theta attains this lower bound. Prefix-language inclusion preserves the distinction for all h>k+1. QED.

For fixed dimension six and credit capacity one per lane, the distinction depth can therefore grow without bound as k increases. The finite state space also grows with k, so this result is compatible with R21's N-1 finite-controller cutoff. The new obstruction is *frame-conditioned replenishment*, not the static-budget path obstruction of R20 or the dense vacancy obstruction of R17-R18.

## Theorem R22.2 — Exact finite BRC update and missing residual

The exact per-lane state is (j_i,d_i,r_i,theta_i) where j_i in {0,...,k} records B_i's position, d_i in {0,1} records whether A_i moved, and r_i in {0,1} is its live credit. Event b_i is enabled iff j_i<k; it increments j_i and on reaching k credits theta_i. Event a_i is enabled iff j_i>=1, d_i=0 and r_i=1; it sets d_i=1 and r_i=0. All other state coordinates are preserved. The observer's Boolean-BRC language is obtained by applying these exact labelled transitions, retaining source and ordered event provenance.

The map discarding theta is not a right-congruence for this transition law: with k=1, the initial visible placement and resource balances agree and both permit b_0, but after b_0, only frame F1 allows a_0. The observer-safe repair coordinate is exactly the hidden frame bit on this fiber. In the m-lane family the sharp repair cost is m bits. The proof is about this specified Boolean successful-word observer; an observer directly reading the full frame can distinguish theta at depth zero.

## Exact finite reproducibility

Code: x6_frame_grant_delayed_residual_r22.py (Python 3 standard library).
Result: x6_frame_grant_delayed_residual_results_r22.json.
Execute: python3 x6_frame_grant_delayed_residual_r22.py

Verified finite domain: m in {1,2,3}, k in {1,2,3,4}, every theta in {0,1}^m and all source/signed-Port words of length <=k+1. The checker independently implements the state transition and a word-prefix count oracle, tests all words in the alphabet, every distinct theta pair and the explicit witnesses b_i^k a_i. Results: 56 theta-controller models, 252 horizon languages, 140 pair comparisons and 124720 individual exact word/oracle checks, all PASS. Arbitrary k,m are supported by the symbolic proof, not by extrapolation. The BRC carrier here is Boolean successful-word support; no amplitude, weighted total, continuous physical time or positive-mass cancellation is used.

## Native admission boundary and next research questions

P000 retains six spatial axes plus non-spatial time, intact stable nonzero triads, native signed Port steps and full frame/branch provenance. The historical candidate model X6_TIME_GUARDED_TRIADIC_RESOURCE_CONFLICT_20261118.md also labels its whole-triad relocation as a candidate rather than an admitted physical law. To upgrade R22, read an authoritative actual TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E Cell/Link/Port transition predicate with authenticated resource grants; determine whether a fixed Port's grant genuinely depends on the closure frame. If it does, test the frame residual against its actual native reachable-state fiber. If it does not, R22 remains a conditional counterexample to unsafe projection only.

Follow-up: model shared credit across lanes to test whether joint guards make memory nonadditive; examine provenance-preserving trace equivalence if native updates include silent events; establish an explicit native event mapping or retain NATIVE_EVENT_ADMISSION_PENDING. None of these conditional results is an independent mathematical review, formal Result freeze or Foundation admission.
